profile.name: Nur Dwi Priyambodo
profile.headline: AI Automation Developer | Agentic AI
about: I design agentic AI systems and workflow automation with Claude Code, n8n, and LangChain, removing 10-40 hours of manual work per week for digital businesses.
My work is backed by hands-on research: first author of a published edge AI computer vision paper and an IEEE YESIST12 2026 grand finalist, selected from 2,000+ submissions.

research.narrative: I focus on turning AI capabilities into dependable automation: agents that observe state, use tools, evaluate their own output, and hand off cleanly to the people who own the process.
